items.descZh: 本文介绍了一系列在线免费数独游戏，旨在通过多样化的谜题进行脑力训练和逻辑提升。核心功能涵盖多种数独变体，包括6x6数独、4x4数独、箭头数独、对角数独、不规则数独、杀手数独、Kropki数独、回文数独和XV数独等，每种游戏都引入独特的规则和约束，如箭头数字和、对角线约束或笼子和限制。亮点在于提供4x4、6x6和9x9等不同网格大小的谜题，难度级别包括简单、中等和困难，例如9x9数独拥有无限谜题，每日更新，适合持续练习。这些游戏适用于初学者、儿童以及需要快速脑力训练的玩家，通过趣味方式增强逻辑思维能力。

items.title: Show HN: Today I deployed this Durable Chat application and was impressed
items.desc: Chat, powered by Durable Objects This chat room is hosted in a single Durable Object, running in one process in one machine in one location, very close to the users.
items.author: DinakarS
items.descZh: 该产品基于 Durable Objects 技术构建，将每个聊天室托管在单一的持久化对象中，实现了极简的单体架构部署。核心机制是聊天室运行于单一进程、单一机器及单一地理位置的进程中，极大地简化了状态维护与数据同步的复杂度。其最大亮点在于通过将服务节点极度贴近用户部署，能够提供超低延迟的实时消息分发与无缝的协同体验。这种架构非常适用于需要强一致性、低延迟且规模可控的轻量级实时多人聊天及互动场景。
items.quote: 该聊天室托管在单个 Durable Object 中，运行在同一位置、同一台机器的同一个进程内，离用户非常近。
items.titleZh: Show HN：今天我部署了这个 Durable Chat 应用程序，印象很深刻。

items.title: Show HN: Avoid smooth spinners, use low-FPS spinners
items.desc: I got so annoyed by various apps (VScode, Chromium, Firefox, Thunderbird) burning CPU/GPU cycles and and making my laptop hot and sluggish with spinners on otherwise static content, that I made this little page to fight this.
items.author: nh2
items.descZh: 背景是主流应用在静态内容上持续消耗CPU/GPU，导致笔记本发热卡顿。核心功能是提供一个极轻量页面，专为展示静态内容而设计，避免不必要的计算开销。亮点在于其极致的资源效率，能显著降低功耗与发热，让设备在浏览静态信息时保持冷静流畅。适用场景包括阅读文档、查看简单网页或作为备用浏览工具，特别适合对性能敏感或设备老旧的用户。

The dashboard uses an eventdriven Kubernetes acquisition pipeline built on clientgo shared informers. For the dashboard, Kubernetes state is maintained in local informer caches, published through ClusterState as immutable cluster snapshots, and analyzed after coalesced resource changes. During healthy steadystate operation, the dashboard does not perform an applicationlevel recurring full Kubernetes LIST cycle. Initial synchronization and watch recovery are handled by clientgo, while recurring analysis runs against cached cluster state. A clockdriven analysis trigger also reevaluates the latest snapshot for timedependent behavior such as incident resolution, resource age, and pricingcache expiry. This reevaluation does not requery Kubernetes. Interactive Investigation remains intentionally separate from the recurring analysis path and may perform targeted Kubernetes API reads when an operator requests deeper evidence. [README.md](/SorBalda/ReinforcementLearningSARSAQLEARNINGDEEPQLEARNING/blob/main/README.md "README.md") View all files Repository files navigation Visualizing a VQC in Reinforcement Learning (frozen lake environment) This project studies variational quantum circuits (VQC) as the actionvalue function in deep Qlearning on a stochastic 4×3 grid world. You can run the gui, setup easily and run the simulation. Look at live performance and live parameters across your circuit. Exact Bellman value iteration provides a reference for learned values and policies. It is part of an internship done in 2024 in Porto University, under the supervision of Prof. Duarte Magano and Ariel Guerreiro. Live visualization [](/SorBalda/ReinforcementLearningSARSAQLEARNINGDEEPQLEARNING/blob/main/vqcrl/docs/assets/livetrainingtabs.gif) [](/SorBalda/ReinforcementLearningSARSAQLEARNINGDEEPQLEARNING/blob/main/vqcrl/docs/assets/trainingmetrics.gif) The first animation replays real checkpoints while the GUI rotates through Circuit, Gradients, and Policy. The second follows MSE, TD loss, discounted reward, learning rate, and epsilon during the same 10,000episode run. Structurally zero gradients are excluded from aggregate statistics. Quick start cd vqcrl python3 m venv .venv .venv/bin/pip install r requirements.txt ./gui.py Tk is required by the GUI. For commandline training, run .venv/bin/python m quantum_rl help. GUI and saved runs The GUI visualizes the circuit, parameter trajectories, gradients, policy, state utilities, rewards, loss, and Bellmanreference error. Each run stores its configuration and reference values alongside progress, policies, plots, parameter history, and gradient statistics. Reproducibility and original implementation Notebookcompatibility mode is verified bitforbit against the original implementation. The original code had a bug: only for the VQC implementation used Q(s_f,a) instead of Q(s_i,a) in the predicted value in the training loop (the classical training loop was not affected by this bug). In this GUI, this bug is fixed. The original notebooks are retained in [original/](/SorBalda/ReinforcementLearningSARSAQLEARNINGDEEPQLEARNING/blob/main/original). for historical attribution to the original internship implementation. items.author: sorbalda
items.descZh: 该项目源于2024年波尔图大学的实习项目，专注于将变分量子电路（VQC）作为动作价值函数应用于深度Q学习，解决随机4×3网格世界（冻结湖环境）中的强化学习问题。核心功能包括一个交互式GUI，支持快速设置和运行模拟，实时可视化电路结构、参数轨迹、梯度、策略及贝尔曼参考误差，并自动存储每次运行的配置、进度和统计图表。亮点在于修复了原始代码中的关键bug，即在训练循环中错误使用Q(s_f,a)而非Q(s_i,a)，确保算法正确性；同时，通过动画展示10,000集训练过程中的MSE、TD损失、折扣奖励等指标，且结构零梯度被排除以优化聚合统计。适用场景涵盖学术研究、教育演示和原型开发，特别适合强化学习与量子计算交叉领域的探索者。
